purpose: Test whether rising-edge same-fret reattack decoding removes the one residual P1 false positive without retraining or threshold changes.
invariants: Decoder V1 boundary-corrected totals and minimum F1 must reproduce diagnostic V2 exactly before decoder V2 is interpreted.
Decoder V2 uses the same model logits and exact thresholds; only same-fret reattack admission changes to a fresh threshold crossing.
No optimizer, model mutation, P2/P3, automatic retry, or full training.
claimBoundary: A pass would show the frozen V3 model plus decoder V2 fits these four P1 training examples. It would not establish generalization. A cross-performer screen would require separate design and authorization.
